comment: The lab's registry fixture (test data only, CLAUDE.md rule 11): one operator with every 2019/947 Art. 14(2) field a legal person gives, its UAS, a receiver and the aircraft the staging smoke flies. The registration number is what uspace-lab's conformance target names in AUTHORITY_CONFORMANCE_OPERATOR for REG-NOPII and NAT-SUCCESS validateRegistry. Loaded through the API by `go test ./deploy/smoke -run TestStagingSmoke` (docs/runbooks/staging.md, 'The registry fixture'); idempotent.
